data.one_liner: Converts HTML and Markdown content into high-quality PDF widgets.
data.what_it_does: Parses HTML strings and Markdown text into structured PDF widgets with a layout-first rendering pipeline. It handles CSS box models, tables, math formulas, lists, and images for generating PDF documents.
use_when: You need to generate PDFs from HTML strings or templates.
You need to convert Markdown documentation into styled PDF pages.
avoid_when: You require a full headless browser engine for complex JavaScript-heavy web pages.
strengths: Supports a wide array of HTML elements, CSS box models, and flexbox features.
Includes MathML support for rendering mathematical notations.
weaknesses: Relies on the provided package implementation rather than a native headless browser, meaning complex CSS layouts might differ from actual browser rendering.
